mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.reference_count), 0) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS reference_count FROM trade_order_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.spu_id = #{productSpuId} AND i.subscription_offer_sku_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(1) AS reference_count FROM trade_order_publication_issue pi WHERE pi.deleted = 0 AND pi.spu_id = #{productSpuId} ) t
